text: シルフ　カンパニーは　グッズを　いっぱい　つくってる　から　ねらわれたんだろうな

structure.jp: シルフ　カンパニーは
グッズを　いっぱい　つくってる　から
ねらわれたんだろうな
structure.en: I guess that's why it was targeted

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: Changing ねらう to ねらわれる turns 'to target' into 'to be targeted': the thing happens to Silph Co. ねらわれた = 'was targeted'.

patterns.name: 〜のだろう
patterns.span: ねらわれたんだろうな
patterns.explanation: んだろう after a verb gives the speaker's guess at the reason behind something; ん is a short spoken の, and な at the end shows he is thinking aloud. ねらわれたんだろうな = 'I guess that's why it was targeted'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something that goes on regularly or is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. つくってる = 'makes, is making'.
